correctness.rationale: At the frozen RESULT.md graph P4 □ P4 with 16 graph vertices and 24 edges, independently reconstructed every one of 10012 augmented matching faces: f-vector (1,24,224,1044,2593,3388,2150,552,36). Reproduced the exact supplied 24-edge toggle ordering, 5002 augmented pairs (5001 ordinary pairs), 8 positive-dimensional critical faces (6 in dimension 4; 2 in dimension 5), and one ordinary critical vertex. Built all 47968 oriented Hasse incidences and processed every face in an acyclic topological sort. Independently computed the full signed integral 2×6 discrete-Morse boundary, all entries zero. The four-skeleton is ∨^6 S^4; Hurewicz identifies π4 with H4 so zero degree of each 5-attachment implies both attaching maps are null. Hence the integral homotopy type ∨^6 S^4 ∨ ∨^2 S^5, not merely mod-two Betti numbers. Exact finite exhaustion is a proof for this specified finite graph, not evidence for any infinite grid family.

value.rationale: The 4×4 square is a canonical finite balanced case beyond the investigated narrow Cartesian-grid families, and a first natural nonouterplanar square test of the open planar matching-complex sphere-wedge prediction. The exact INTEGRAL homotopy type, with independent adjacent 4- and 5-dimensional spheres and attaching-map control, is mathematically stronger than face counts or finite-field Betti tables. The precise result can serve as a necessary benchmark for any future width-four grid recurrence; it does not pretend to solve the all-grid problem.

limitations: Finite 4×4 graph only; no recurrence for 4×n or all planar graphs.
Full source text of all plausibly relevant small-grid publications not available; best-of-knowledge originality, not worldwide priority proof.
